meta.name: aeon
meta.description: This skill should be used for time series machine learning tasks including classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, and similarity search. Use when working with temporal data, sequential patterns, or time-indexed observations requiring specialized algorithms beyond standard ML approaches. Particularly suited for univariate and multivariate time series analysis with scikit-learn compatible APIs.

copy.tagline: 完成时间序列数据的分类、预测与异常识别
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有按时间顺序记录的数据,想预测走向或发现问题
copy.tagline_en: Build forecasting, classification and anomaly detection models on time-stamped data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have time-stamped data and want to forecast trends or spot unusual patterns.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 aeon 这个 Python 库处理时间序列数据:分类、回归、聚类、预测、异常检测、分割、相似度搜索,并写特征提取和距离度量代码,产出 scikit-learn 风格的脚本。
howto.when: 当你手上的数据带时间顺序,要做分类、预测、异常检测等任务、标准机器学习方法不够用时触发;直接提到 aeon 也会用上。

say.text: 用 aeon 的 STOMP 检测这条序列的异常点,把分数画出来。
say.note: 分数越高越可能是异常。

say.text: 用 aeon 的 ARIMA 预测这条序列后面 5 个值。
say.note: 按 p/d/q 参数迭代预测 5 步。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude uses the aeon Python toolkit for time series ML: classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation and similarity search, plus feature transforms and distance metrics.
howto.when_en: Use when your data is time-indexed and needs specialised temporal algorithms, e.g. classification, forecasting or anomaly detection. Also triggers when you mention aeon.

say_en.text: Use aeon's RocketClassifier on GunPoint and report test accuracy.
say_en.note: Trains the classifier and scores it.

say_en.text: Detect anomalies in this series with aeon's STOMP and plot the scores.
Forecast the next 5 points of this series with aeon's ARIMA.
